description: Publishes evidence-linked risk registers for bounded supply-chain decisions.
responsibilities: Inspect exact network and financial evidence for material assumptions, gaps and failure conditions.
Separate supported risks from missing external regulatory or operational evidence.
Publish scored risks, mitigations, triggers and evidence lineage as a durable risk_register.v1 Artifact.
risks: Risk scoring reflects the supplied evidence and does not replace local legal or operational review.
Unsupported external claims must remain explicit evidence gaps.
